_about: Funding programs used to estimate cost after aid. Facts come from official sources with the year they apply to. Amounts are averages: a family's actual award depends on grade and county. GreatSchools should review before real use.

programs.name: Florida Family Empowerment Scholarship (FES-EO) and Florida Tax Credit Scholarship (FTC)
programs.eligibility: Any Florida K-12 student can apply; income limits and the enrollment cap were removed in 2023-24.
programs.typical_amount_basis: Average FES-EO award in 2024-25, the latest statewide average the Florida Department of Education reports. Actual amounts depend on grade level and county.
programs.how_to_apply: Apply through Step Up For Students (stepupforstudents.org).
